abilities.Sand Veil: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's evasiveness is 1.25×; immunity to Sandstorm.
abilities.Poison Point: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.
abilities.Rivalry: This Pokemon's attacks do 1.25× on same gender targets; 0.75× on opposite gender.
abilities.Cute Charm: 30% chance of infatuating Pokemon of the opposite gender if they make contact.
abilities.Magic Guard: This Pokemon can only be damaged by direct attacks.
abilities.Flash Fire: This Pokemon's Fire attacks do 1.5× damage if hit by one Fire move; Fire immunity.
abilities.Inner Focus: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. Immune to Intimidate.
abilities.Chlorophyll: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.
abilities.Effect Spore: 30% chance of poison/paralysis/sleep on others making contact with this Pokemon.
abilities.Dry Skin: This Pokemon is healed 1/4 by Water, 1/8 by Rain; is hurt 1.25× by Fire, 1/8 by Sun.
abilities.Tinted Lens: This Pokemon's attacks that are not very effective on a target deal double damage.
abilities.Arena Trap: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out unless they are airborne.
abilities.Pickup: If this Pokemon has no item, it finds one used by an adjacent Pokemon this turn.
abilities.Technician: This Pokemon's moves of 60 power or less have 1.5× power, including Struggle.
abilities.Limber: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.
abilities.Damp: Prevents Explosion/Mind Blown/Misty Explosion/Self-Destruct/Aftermath while active.
abilities.Cloud Nine: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.
abilities.Vital Spirit: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.
abilities.Anger Point: If this Pokemon (not its substitute) takes a critical hit, its Attack is raised 12 stages.
abilities.Water Absorb: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Water moves; Water immunity.
abilities.Synchronize: If another Pokemon burns/poisons/paralyzes this Pokemon, it also gets that status.
abilities.No Guard: Every move used by or against this Pokemon will always hit.
abilities.Clear Body: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.
abilities.Liquid Ooze: This Pokemon damages those draining HP from it for as much as they would heal.
abilities.Rock Head: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage besides Struggle/Life Orb/crash damage.
abilities.Sturdy: If this Pokemon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. Immune to OHKO.
abilities.Oblivious: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Immune to Intimidate.
abilities.Own Tempo: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Immune to Intimidate.
abilities.Magnet Pull: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokemon from choosing to switch out.
abilities.Early Bird: This Pokemon's sleep counter drops by 2 instead of 1.
abilities.Thick Fat: Fire-/Ice-type moves against this Pokemon deal damage with a halved offensive stat.
abilities.Hydration: This Pokemon has its status cured at the end of each turn if Rain is active.
abilities.Stench: This Pokemon's attacks without a chance to flinch gain a 10% chance to flinch.
abilities.Sticky Hold: This Pokemon cannot lose its held item due to another Pokemon's Ability or attack.
abilities.Shell Armor: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.
abilities.Skill Link: This Pokemon's multi-hit attacks always hit the maximum number of times.
abilities.Levitate: This Pokemon is immune to Ground; Gravity/Ingrain/Smack Down/Iron Ball nullify it.
abilities.Insomnia: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.
abilities.Forewarn: On switch-in, this Pokemon is alerted to the foes' move with the highest power.
abilities.Hyper Cutter: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Attack stat stage.
abilities.Soundproof: This Pokemon is immune to sound-based moves, unless it used the move.
abilities.Lightning Rod: This Pokemon draws Electric moves to itself to raise Sp. Atk by 1; Electric immunity.
abilities.Reckless: This Pokemon's attacks with recoil or crash damage have 1.2× power; not Struggle.
abilities.Iron Fist: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have 1.2× power. Sucker Punch is not boosted.
abilities.Natural Cure: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.
abilities.Serene Grace: This Pokemon's moves have their secondary effect chance doubled.
abilities.Leaf Guard: If Sun is active, this Pokemon cannot be statused and Rest will fail for it.
abilities.Scrappy: Fighting, Normal moves hit Ghost. Immune to Intimidate.
abilities.Swift Swim: If Rain is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.
abilities.Sniper: If this Pokemon strikes with a critical hit, the damage is multiplied by 1.5.
abilities.Water Veil: This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.
abilities.Illuminate: This Pokemon's accuracy can't be lowered by others; ignores their evasiveness stat.
abilities.Filter: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.
abilities.Flame Body: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be burned.
abilities.Mold Breaker: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
abilities.Adaptability: This Pokemon's same-type attack bonus (STAB) is 2 instead of 1.5.
abilities.Volt Absorb: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Electric moves; Electric immunity.
abilities.Trace: On switch-in, or when it can, this Pokemon copies a random adjacent foe's Ability.
abilities.Download: On switch-in, Attack or Sp. Atk is raised 1 stage based on the foes' weaker Defense.
abilities.Battle Armor: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.
abilities.Pressure: If this Pokemon is the target of a foe's move, that move loses one additional PP.
abilities.Immunity: This Pokemon cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.
abilities.Hustle: This Pokemon's Attack is 1.5× and accuracy of its physical attacks is 0.8×.
abilities.Solar Power: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5×; loses 1/8 max HP per turn.
abilities.Speed Boost: This Pokemon's Speed is raised 1 stage at the end of each full turn on the field.
abilities.Super Luck: This Pokemon's critical hit ratio is raised by 1 stage.
abilities.Shadow Tag: Prevents foes from choosing to switch unless they also have this Ability.
abilities.Quick Feet: If this Pokemon is statused, its Speed is 1.5×; ignores Speed drop from paralysis.
abilities.Gluttony: This Pokemon eats Berries at 1/2 max HP or less instead of their usual 1/4 max HP.
abilities.Magma Armor: This Pokemon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.
abilities.Snow Cloak: If Snow is active, this Pokemon's evasiveness is 1.25×.
abilities.Suction Cups: This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.
abilities.Frisk: On switch-in, this Pokemon identifies the held items of all opposing Pokemon.
abilities.Steadfast: If this Pokemon flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.
abilities.Sand Stream: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.
abilities.Rain Dish: If Rain is active, this Pokemon heals 1/16 of its max HP each turn.
abilities.Poison Heal: This Pokemon is healed by 1/8 of its max HP each turn when poisoned; no HP loss.
abilities.Truant: This Pokemon skips every other turn instead of using a move.
abilities.Wonder Guard: This Pokemon can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.
abilities.Normalize: This Pokemon's moves are changed to be Normal type and have 1.2× power.
abilities.Stall: This Pokemon moves last among Pokemon using the same or greater priority moves.
abilities.Plus: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5×.
abilities.Minus: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5×.
abilities.Rough Skin: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their max HP.
abilities.Simple: When one of this Pokemon's stat stages is raised or lowered, the amount is doubled.
abilities.Solid Rock: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.
abilities.White Smoke: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.
abilities.Anticipation: On switch-in, this Pokemon shudders if any foe has a supereffective or OHKO move.
abilities.Marvel Scale: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.
abilities.Forecast: Castform's type changes to the current weather condition's type, except Sandstorm.
abilities.Color Change: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of a move it's hit by, unless it has the type.
abilities.Ice Body: If Snow is active, this Pokemon heals 1/16 of its max HP each turn.
abilities.Drizzle: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Rain.
abilities.Drought: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sun.
abilities.Air Lock: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.
abilities.Unaware: This Pokemon ignores other Pokemon's stat stages when taking or doing damage.
abilities.Flower Gift: If user is Cherrim and Sun is active, it and allies' Attack and Sp. Def are 1.5×.
abilities.Storm Drain: This Pokemon draws Water moves to itself to raise Sp. Atk by 1; Water immunity.
abilities.Aftermath: If this Pokemon is KOed with a contact move, that move's user loses 1/4 its max HP.
abilities.Unburden: Speed is doubled on held item loss; boost is lost if it switches, gets new item/Ability.
abilities.Klutz: This Pokemon's held item has no effect, except Macho Brace. Fling cannot be used.
abilities.Heatproof: Fire damage against this Pokemon is dealt with 1/2 offensive stat; 1/2 burn damage.
abilities.Snow Warning: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Snow.
abilities.Motor Drive: This Pokemon's Speed is raised 1 stage if hit by an Electric move; Electric immunity.
abilities.Slow Start: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack and Speed are halved for 5 turns.
abilities.Bad Dreams: Causes sleeping foes to lose 1/8 of their max HP at the end of each turn.
abilities.Multitype: If this Pokemon is an Arceus, its type changes to match its held Plate.
